{{Quote|<nowiki />''Go-zeki''&hellip; Feed the dogs.|A Chiggnash, directing their ''go-zeki'' warrior drone into battle|<ref name="Wolf" />}}
The '''''go-zeki''''' were a group of [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] of the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known for fanatical honor and [[Death/Legends|deadly]] skill in battle. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''go-zeki'' were active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Description==
The ''go-zeki'' were a [[Death/Legends|deadly]] criminal gang with fanatical honor. Its [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] members were initiated in a ritual [[Fire/Legends|burning]] of flesh, charring the [[Species/Legends|species']] naturally [[Color/Legends|green]] skin orange. Certain ''go-zeki'' [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] wore the [[Breath mask/Legends|oxygen masks]] and [[Clothing/Legends|skirts]] typical of the Kyuzo and wielded [[fiber-chained razorhat]]s, used both as garments and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].<ref name="Wolf" />

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke]]" are concurrent to {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> three ''go-zeki'' outside [[The Hoary Piffer]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] were accosted for aid in fighting the trafficking of [[Youngling/Legends|children]] on the moon by a [[Rakaan]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] by incognito [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. However, these same ''go-zeki'' fell under the [[Control Mind (Chiggnash)|mind control]] of the [[Chiggnash]] [[Banda (Chiggnash)|Banda]] and [[Riley (Chiggnash)|Riley]]. Each escorting a leashed, [[Cyborrean rabies|rabid]] [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dog]], the three Kyuzo [[warrior drone]]s supported their masters in their attempt to [[Thief/Legends|rob]] Kenobi, unleashing the frog-dogs at the Chiggnash's command. As the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] slew the [[Disease/Legends|diseased]] [[amphibicanoid]]s, the ''go-zeki'' prepared to attack, only to be cut down by the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Fomadu]], who [[Cho mok/Legends|severed]] the Kyuzos' [[Limb/Legends|legs]] at the knee and impaled them through their heads with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as they pleaded for their lives.<ref name="Wolf" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''go-zeki'' appeared in the short story "[[Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke]]" by [[Abel G. Peña]],<ref name="Wolf" /> which was released on Peña's website on [[March 6]], [[2015]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52204636|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[John Hazlett|jSarek]]|date=2015-05-11|time=8:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160831095014/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/}}</ref>
